newsitem.title: USA: Harold's Stores stake upped by Laifer group.
newsitem.headline: Harold's Stores stake upped by Laifer group.

text.p: A group led by Laifer Capital Management Inc said Tuesday it raised its stake in Harold's Stores Inc to 565,908 common shares or 9.9 percent from 8.7 percent previously held.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions were purchased between April 25 and June 20 at prices ranging from $8.5275 to $11.875 per share.
The group said it holds the stake in the Norman, Olka., based retailer for investment purposes.
